description: Rename this brand, only when the user asks for it. The new name shows on every page, in the brand switcher and in posts from now on, and it counts as set by the user, so brand_save keeps it. Changes nothing else; posts already published keep the name they went out with.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

name.description: The brand’s new name, as the user said it: one line, up to 80 characters.

name: brand_rename
title: Rename the brand
